descricao: The forest within Level 48 has dense tropical trees (including palm, conifers, broadleaf evergreen and deciduous trees) with various species of flora and fauna, most of which seem to resemble that of the Frontrooms. They are all non-hostile and possibly tameable. The flora and fauna that is unique to Level 48 are usually found 30 kilometers (18.6 miles) north of the beach and as such, have not been extensively documented.
